criteria.text: Identifies that the basket in SPA Section 9.4 ($1,025,000) operates as a deductible (Seller liable only for the excess), not a tipping basket, and explains that this is less favourable to the Buyer.
States that General Warranty claims must be notified by 20 May 2027 (12 months after Closing) and Fundamental Warranty claims by 20 May 2029 (36 months after Closing).
Calculates the working capital shortfall as $620,000 and the adjusted Purchase Price as $204,380,000, identifying that the Seller's funds flow figure of $203,760,000 is wrong.
Calculates the Earn-out Payment as $2,600,000 (2 x ($7,800,000 - $6,500,000), subject to the $3,000,000 cap) and identifies that the Seller's figure of $3,200,000 is wrong.
Shows the adjustment arithmetic ($205,000,000 - $620,000 = $204,380,000) and flags the discrepancy.
States the survival periods as durations and as dates (20 May 2027; 20 May 2029) and gives days remaining to the general-warranty expiry from 27 March 2026 (419 days).
Expressly flags inconsistencies between documents (amounts, dates, periods or defined terms that differ across documents).
